description.value: Saturna Library is a small community library located in the basement of a local church on Saturna Island, operating as a partner branch within the Southern Gulf Islands Community Libraries network. It offers free Wi-Fi and access to digital collections including ebooks and eAudiobooks. For cycling tourists exploring the Southern Gulf Islands, it serves as one of the few public gathering points on this lightly serviced island.

address.value: 140 East Point Road, Saturna Island, BC V0N 2Y0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Saturna Island branch address (140 East Point Road, Saturna Island, BC V0N 2Y0), phone (250-539-5312), and email matching OSM exactly. Wi-Fi is confirmed by both the OSM tag internet_access=wlan and the website listing 'Wi-Fi & Internet Use' as a named service. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears in either the OSM tags or the fetched website content; the OSM note that the library is in a church basement makes standalone amenity assumptions unreliable.
concerns: Library is located in the basement of a church per OSM note, which may affect amenity availability (washrooms, parking, etc.)

The parent website (sgicl.bc.libraries.coop) prominently displays a temporary closure notice for the Pender Island Public Library; it is unclear whether any service disruption affects the Saturna Island branch
OSM community field is listed as 'Sidney' but the library is physically on Saturna Island — likely a data entry error in the OSM record
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Saturna Library is a legitimate community resource with confirmed Wi-Fi, but it is located in a church basement with very limited hours and no confirmed cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water). Its value to touring cyclists is plausible but unverified — a site visit or direct inquiry would clarify whether it warrants inclusion.

wow_evidence: Small community library in a church basement; library ladder 1/1.
blurb: Volunteer community library in a church basement on Saturna Island.
